content.title: Recognize these little ones?
content.text: Time flew by without us noticing. And now the moment has come when our childhood dreams are coming true. Share the biggest event of our summer with us — your love and support mean the world to us!

content.title: Save the date
content.message: Don’t miss the biggest event of our summer — our wedding day!

content.text: We’re counting down and getting ready for our unforgettable day! Join in with your smiles and hugs — and with beautiful outfits in the colors of our celebration

content.title: A few wishes
content.text: We’d be grateful if you skipped clinking glasses to make us kiss. A kiss is a way to show our feelings, and it can’t happen on demand.
If you have any questions about the day, feel free to reach out to us:

content.text: Please don’t bring us flowers! We won’t have time to enjoy their beauty and scent. If you’d like to give us something meaningful and useful, we’d be very grateful for a contribution to our new family’s budget.
Bring the whole family! There will be activities for kids of all ages. While you relax and share happy moments with us, the children will be busy with a professional entertainer.
